versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Skill Name Generator.
- Generate compliant and SEO-friendly Skill names in both English and Chinese based on feature descriptions.
- Provides 2–3 English and Chinese naming options, ensuring English names are 2–4 words using lowercase and hyphens.
- Incorporates platform names (e.g., WeChat, Douyin) when relevant for better search visibility.
- Includes detailed naming rationale, SEO analysis, and keyword extraction for each suggestion.
